summary: Completed testing of GitHub Repository Crawler feature. All 10 backend tests passed. All frontend features verified working correctly including scan, file selection, import with SSE progress, and source list updates.
critical_code_review_comments: GitHub scan endpoint correctly parses owner/repo from URL and handles branch auto-detection
Import stream uses SSE with proper event types (progress, success, error, done)
GitHub sources stored with type='github' and include source_repo, source_branch, source_path metadata
File categorization (_doc_file_category) correctly identifies README, changelog, docs, examples, etc.
Large files are chunked using _split_into_chunks with group_id for multi-part sources
Frontend SSE consumer correctly routes success/error/done events to onComplete handler
seed_data_creation: Created TEST_GitHub_Import category source during import test, cleaned up after
